sample: The tracked file keeps one row in 4 of the 417,535 the query returns, in catalogue order (sorted by right ascension). Presentation choice: enough stars for the 800 pc level of the Milky Way's dots (tracers/merge.json) at 1,500 dots per kpc², where the catalogue holds about 8,000.
meaning: Hot luminous stars (OBA) of Zari et al. (2021), their filtered sample, each at its median astro-kinematic distance (d50kin): the young disc across the whole sky out to several kiloparsecs.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the blue-white of hot stars.

toneBy.basis: Presentation of a measured quantity: each star's absolute Ks magnitude (Ksmag at its d50kin) darkens its color, from full at M_Ks -2.5 to 45% at 0, linear in magnitude. Zari et al. select stars brighter than about M_Ks 0, and the bounds are about the 5th and 95th percentiles of the sample (-2.48 and -0.05). Ks is not corrected for dust, which dims it far less than visible light.
